nodes.description: Constant string state variable 'RWA-001' declared as public constant.
Constant string state variable 'RWA001' declared as public constant.
Constant uint8 state variable set to 18.
Public uint256 total supply, set to 1*WAD in the constructor.
Public mapping(address=>uint256) holding token balances; written by constructor and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) holding spend approvals; written by approve and transferFrom.
Constant uint256 = 10**18 used as the initial token amount.
Internal pure helper computing z = x + y with a require guard; used to credit balances in transferFrom.
Internal pure helper computing z = x - y with a require guard; used to debit balances and allowances in transferFrom.
Constructor minting 1*WAD to balanceOf[msg.sender] and setting totalSupply.
External transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
Public transferFrom that checks balance and allowance, updates allowance/balanceOf via add/sub and emits Transfer.
External approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][usr] = wad and emits Approval.
Caller-controlled address used as minter in the constructor, as allowance owner in approve, and as src/allowance owner in transfer/transferFrom.
Unchecked uint256 addition z = x + y inside add() (Solidity 0.5.12 has no built-in overflow protection; only a require guard).
Unchecked uint256 subtraction z = x - y inside sub() (Solidity 0.5.12 has no built-in underflow protection; only a require guard).
First uint256 parameter of add().
Second uint256 parameter of add().
First uint256 parameter of sub().
Second uint256 parameter of sub().
Destination address parameter of transfer(), forwarded to transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer(), forwarded to transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom(), indexes balanceOf and allowance.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom(), indexes the credited balanceOf entry.
Amount parameter of transferFrom(), compared with balance/allowance and passed to add/sub.
Spender address parameter of approve(), used as the inner allowance key.
Allowance amount parameter of approve(), stored directly into allowance.
Local return variable of add() holding the result of the addition.
Local return variable of sub() holding the result of the subtraction.

edges.reason: Parameter x is an operand of the unchecked addition in add().
Parameter y is an operand of the unchecked addition in add().
The result of the unchecked addition is assigned to local variable z.
Local z is returned as the result of add().
Parameter x is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in sub().
Parameter y is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in sub().
The result of the unchecked subtraction is assigned to local variable z.
Local z is returned as the result of sub().
Constructor keys the initial mint on the untrusted caller msg.sender.
Constructor writes the minted amount into balanceOf.
Constructor sets totalSupply to 1*WAD.
transfer delegates all accounting to transferFrom.
transfer forwards its dst parameter into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its wad parameter into transferFrom.
transfer uses the untrusted caller msg.sender as the source of funds.
transferFrom compares src != msg.sender and reads/updates allowance[src][msg.sender].
src indexes the balanceOf mapping read for the balance check and debit.
src indexes the outer key of the allowance mapping.
wad is compared against balanceOf[src] before the debit.
wad is subtracted from allowance[src][msg.sender].
transferFrom stores the debited src balance and credited dst balance into balanceOf.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom calls sub() for the allowance and balance debits, inheriting its unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom calls add() to credit the destination balance, inheriting its unchecked arithmetic.
dst indexes the balanceOf entry credited by transferFrom.
approve writes the new allowance into the allowance mapping.
approve keys the allowance outer index on the untrusted caller msg.sender.
usr is used as the inner allowance key in approve.
wad is written directly as the allowance value without any validation.

normalization_plan.reason: add.x is only an operand of the unchecked addition node and carries no independent semantics.
add.y is only an operand of the unchecked addition node and carries no independent semantics.
sub.x is only an operand of the unchecked subtraction node and carries no independent semantics.
sub.y is only an operand of the unchecked subtraction node and carries no independent semantics.
add.z solely receives the result of the unchecked addition operation.
sub.z solely receives the result of the unchecked subtraction operation.
transfer.dst is forwarded unchanged into the transferFrom core function.
transfer.wad is forwarded unchanged into the transferFrom core function.
transferFrom.src is only used as a mapping key inside the transferFrom core function.
transferFrom.dst is only used as a mapping key inside the transferFrom core function.
transferFrom.wad is only compared and forwarded to add/sub inside transferFrom.
approve.usr is only used as the allowance key inside the approve core function.
approve.wad is only stored as the allowance value inside the approve core function.
